adjudication.rationale: In test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6, the Pretender handler for `this.get('/fruits/:id', ...)` ignores `:id` and always returns `const fruit = fruits[0];` (apple). Meanwhile, the updated store test (test/javascripts/models/store-test.js.es6) calls `store.find('fruit', 2)` and asserts properties (e.g., `colors` length 2 with ids 1 and 2) that match `fruits[0]` (apple has `color_ids: [1,2]`), not banana (`fruits[1]` has `color_ids: [3]`). This makes the test incorrectly coupled to the mock bug and would fail once the mock is fixed to respect `:id`.
